chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Frankie Newton
summary: McRae recalls trumpeter Frankie Newton, who died young, and Rudy Powell from the 14th Street band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Frankie Newton -- that's the trumpet player I was telling you about. He died young, real young.
Frankie Newton was an outstanding trumpet player. Good recording man. He made a lot of -- I think he made a lot of recordings.
I did this particular date with Frankie. That's another record -- I think I had record of that (inaudible) -- I think I heard that album because I would love Frankie.
Frankie and I would work -- we worked some dancing school things together. Frankie was out that age too.
Rudy Powell was in the band with me and June Clark down on 14th Street. That was the alto player -- Rudy Powell.
This one has Frankie Newton, Benny Morton, Jerry Blake --
